question: Can an XRPL escrow hold RLUSD today, and what must the issuer enable before a buyer can lock it?

plan.restatement: Whether XRPL escrows can hold RLUSD today and what the issuer must enable before a buyer can lock it.
subqueries: XRPL escrow token escrow amendment issuer enable

requirements.text: Whether XRPL escrow can hold RLUSD today, with date
What the issuer must enable before a buyer can lock RLUSD in escrow
Any XRPL amendment or feature governing token escrow for RLUSD

lead: Not today: an XRPL escrow can hold official RLUSD only after its issuer enables AllowTrustLineLocking, and the RLUSD issuer had not enabled it on Mainnet or Testnet when the team checked on 11 November 2026.
conclusion: Not today: an XRPL escrow can hold official RLUSD only after its issuer enables AllowTrustLineLocking, and the RLUSD issuer had not enabled it on Mainnet or Testnet when the team checked on 11 November 2026. The TokenEscrow amendment (XLS-85), which lets an escrow hold issued tokens, is already enabled on both networks, so the issuer flag is the remaining blocker. Only the issuer can set that flag, with an AccountSet transaction; a buyer or writer cannot set it for them. The issuer is separate from buyer and writer. Policy rejects issuer-as-party, missing permission, nonzero transfer fees, frozen/unauthorized lines, insufficient balance or destination limit before create signing. Cancellation checks the buyer's returned balance delta.
